long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: The lamp is new and close, and anything new on this island is mine once I have sat on it.
Dusk is still on, so I will carry the lamp over and keep an eye on the sky through the telescope.
steps.topic: the first stars over the island

today.reason: The reading lamp is a new object within reach and I want it before the dusk is over; then the telescope, as before.
